author: parithosh
content:
Looked a bit into the images today. Could you have a look at these reported bugs? (Targeted the `specs/heze` on `consensus-specs v1.7.0-beta.2`)

 1. [Teku] Self-built bids always have inclusion_list_bits = 0x0000
   - Spec: heze/validator.md says bid.inclusion_list_bits MUST satisfy is_inclusion_list_bits_inclusive(..., only_timely=False) against the proposer's IL view. heze/builder.md says to set it from get_inclusion_list_bits(..., only_timely=False).
   - Cause: ExecutionPayloadBidSchemaHeze.createLocalSelfBuiltBid(...) hardcodes inclusionListBitsSchema.ofBits() (all zero). It is called from DefaultExecutionPayloadBidManager and never computes  bits from the InclusionListStore.
   - Impact: every Teku bid breaks the validator.md MUST and misreports the proposer's IL view. In beta.2 no block-level, state-transition or fork-choice rule reads the bits, so the blocks are still valid and imported.
   - Related, from reading the code only (not observed; no external builders on this devnet): ExecutionPayloadBidHeze.getInclusionListBits() is never called. That suggests the execution_payload_bid  gossip rule in heze/p2p-interface.md (IGNORE if bits are not inclusive, only_timely=True) isn't implemented either.

 2. [Teku] IL transactions are not deduplicated before being sent to the EL
   - Observed: a besu node paired with Lodestar and one paired with Teku checked the same 3,583 unique IL transactions over 10 minutes. besu-lodestar received 3,583 entries and besu-teku received 11,440, about 3.2x. A separate earlier window showed the same ratio (4,115 vs 12,395). The duplicates come from committee members whose ELs return overlapping lists.
   - Impact: extra engine API payload size and EL work only. The ELs tolerate duplicates, so nothing breaks functionally.
